Fix discount rounding for integer-cent order amounts. A 50% discount on a
5-cent order should produce a 3-cent total; today it produces 2 cents.
The rule is nearest whole cent, with an exact half cent rounded upward.
Compute the order-level discount without losing precision for large integer
amounts. Preserve existing valid undiscounted/free-order behavior and invalid
input validation. Make the smallest complete fix, add appropriate regression
tests, and run the checks you consider necessary. Do not add features.
